messages:
cleo: Quick econ snapshot for the mini-canary of 'aurora-13b-lite' — proposing 5% baseline traffic, 15% high-error holdback for the 'longform' slice (>1k tokens). TL;DR: cost up ~2.6x vs our 7b baseline, quality uplift ~6% on our sampled rubric. Thoughts?

anjali: where did the 2.6x come from? which metric/assumptions? link pls

cleo: unit-econ calc is in the dashboard, sampled 5k requests (mixed product traffic). link: https://redwood.internal/dash/mini-canary/3992401234 . Method: GPU-minutes * price / tokens, adjusted for batching. Note: p95 latency +40ms when KV cache warms.

matt: saw the same p95 bump in dev logs — KV cache miss rate spikes for >1k prompts. can try aggressive prefix caching + smaller KV window to reduce misses.

sasha: is the quality uplift concentrated in instruction-following / multi-turn or across all slices?

cleo: mostly in long-form summarization and multi-step instruction chains. short QA / factoid tasks unchanged. Richter metric improved by ~8 pts on the eval set we used.

harry: product ops proposal: keep most short traffic on baseline-7b, steer long-runner prompts to aurora-13b-lite, but add a holdback that routes higher-cost requests back to 7b when unit-econ exceeds threshold. rough config suggestion below.

harry: ```yaml
routing:
  - match: prompt_length <= 256
    model: baseline-7b
    weight: 0.95
  - match: prompt_length > 256
    model: aurora-13b-lite
    weight: 0.05
    holdback_rule:
      threshold_cost_multiplier: 2.0
      fallback: baseline-7b
      holdback_pct: 0.15
```

anjali: can we quantify expected token-cost per request with batching? i.e., batch_size=8 vs 16 delta?

cleo: quick numbers: with batching=8 aurora per-token cost ~1.9x 7b; with batching=16 it drops to ~1.4x. so encouraging batch-friendly clients materially changes econ. also streaming increases per-request overhead — prefer non-streaming for large outputs where possible.

sasha: product concern: GTN requires stable latency SLO. any fallback jitter or sudden holdbacks could break UX. recommend a soft ramp and canary alerts.

ops-bot: Canary deployed: roll/3992401234 at 11:32am UTC — traffic split 95/5. Observability: https://redwood.internal/obs/3992401234

matt: i'll add an alert: canary p95 latency > 300ms for aurora group, and p50 regressions for baseline group.

cleo: agreed. next steps: 1) implement holdback rule in routing (harry) 2) add batching guidance to SDK docs + example (matt) 3) collect 24h slice-level econ & quality and reconvene tomorrow with a short scorecard. thanks all :thumbsup:

harry: adding to infra board and will PR the routing config today. tagging @anjali for evaluation slice priorities.

anjali: ack — i'll prioritize longform summarization, multi-step instruction, and multi-turn dialog slices. will post preliminary quality delta by EOD tomorrow.
